Setup.Name: Customizing user properties
Setup.Description: Customize the creation of setting attributes via user properties.
Setup.Manifest:
Processors:
  - Name: "Processor Temperature"
    Description: "Provides the current processor temperature."
    Mqtt: 
      Subscriptions:
        - Name: "Processor information"
          Topic: "message-topic"
    Otel:
      Metrics:
        - Name: "Processor.Temperature"
          Description: "The current processor temperature."
          CreateAttributesFromUserProperties: false
          SignalDataType: Float
          Instrument: Gauge
          Attributes:
            - Key: "Criticality"
              Value: "$(UserProperty('Category'))"
          Value: "PAYLOAD()"
